notes.title: Leaf Me Alone New Year Update!!!
notes.content:
Several interactable objects have been added!

- Pinata
Shoot the leaves and pop the pinata.

- Fan
Fly the leaves with a fan.

From now on, our cleaning robot A12 must not only clean up the leaves, but also complete various tasks!

Additionally, some bugs have been solved.

Have fun cleaning the leaves.

notes.title: Leaf Me Alone Update
notes.content:
Leaf Me Alone update

1. It was easy to confuse the Load button and the Start button.
> Interface has been improved to reduce these cases.

2. It was not intuitive what the collection meant.
> Also improved the interface.

3. There was a problem with the leaves not falling from the air.
> Fixed bugs. If this bug persists, please report it.


This is to be updated later.
Interactable objects will be added to several stages.
Depending on such an object, the existing simple game method will become a little more colorful.
However, the gameplay of Leaf Me Alone, which pursues easy and simple, will not change much.


Thank you for playing Leaf Me Alone.

notes.title: Bug Hotfix
notes.content:
We have fixed the bug found since the launch of Leaf me alone.

1. A bug that does not operate right click after emptying the trash can robot.

> There was a problem with the crash decision during the opening of the trash can robot.
There was a bug when the trash can was emptied from a particular location.

2. Visual problems on the floor on a particular map

> There was a problem of fine gaps in the bottom of the eagle river map.

I will try to fix it quickly if there is a bug.
I'd appreciate it if you could report using the news and community functions.
